1→//! Power and heart rate zone calculations.

     3→//! T015: Define PowerZones, HRZones, ZoneRange structs

     8→use serde::{Deserialize, Serialize};

    10→/// RGB color representation.
    11→#[derive(Debug, Clone, Copy, PartialEq, Serialize, Deserialize)]
    12→pub struct Color {
    13→    pub r: u8,
    14→    pub g: u8,
    15→    pub b: u8,

    17→
    18→impl Color {
    19→    pub const fn new(r: u8, g: u8, b: u8) -> Self {

    21→    }
    22→
    23→    /// Convert to egui color format.
    24→    pub fn to_egui(&self) -> [u8; 3] {

    27→}

    29→/// A power zone range.
    30→#[derive(Debug, Clone, Serialize, Deserialize)]
    31→pub struct ZoneRange {
    32→    /// Zone number (1-7 for power, 1-5 for HR)
    33→    pub zone: u8,
    34→    /// Minimum percentage of FTP
    35→    pub min_percent: u8,
    36→    /// Maximum percentage of FTP (255 = no upper limit)
    37→    pub max_percent: u8,
    38→    /// Minimum watts for this zone
    39→    pub min_watts: u16,
    40→    /// Maximum watts for this zone
    41→    pub max_watts: u16,
    42→    /// Display color
    43→    pub color: Color,
    44→    /// Zone name
    45→    pub name: String,
    46→}
    47→
    48→/// A heart rate zone range.
    49→#[derive(Debug, Clone, Serialize, Deserialize)]
    50→pub struct HRZoneRange {
    51→    /// Zone number (1-5)
    52→    pub zone: u8,
    53→    /// Minimum BPM
    54→    pub min_bpm: u8,
    55→    /// Maximum BPM
    56→    pub max_bpm: u8,

    63→/// Coggan 7-zone power zones.
    64→#[derive(Debug, Clone, Serialize, Deserialize)]
    65→#[serde(default)]
    66→pub struct PowerZones {
    67→    /// Zone 1: Active Recovery (0-55% FTP)
    68→    pub z1_recovery: ZoneRange,
    69→    /// Zone 2: Endurance (56-75% FTP)
    70→    pub z2_endurance: ZoneRange,
    71→    /// Zone 3: Tempo (76-90% FTP)
    72→    pub z3_tempo: ZoneRange,
    73→    /// Zone 4: Threshold (91-105% FTP)
    74→    pub z4_threshold: ZoneRange,
    75→    /// Zone 5: VO2max (106-120% FTP)
    76→    pub z5_vo2max: ZoneRange,
    77→    /// Zone 6: Anaerobic (121-150% FTP)
    78→    pub z6_anaerobic: ZoneRange,
    79→    /// Zone 7: Neuromuscular (>150% FTP)
    80→    pub z7_neuromuscular: ZoneRange,
    81→    /// Whether zones are user-customized
    82→    pub custom: bool,
    83→}
    84→
    85→impl PowerZones {
    86→    /// Calculate power zones from FTP using Coggan 7-zone model.
    87→    pub fn from_ftp(ftp: u16) -> Self {
    88→        // Helper to calculate watts from percentage, using round() to avoid
    89→        // floating-point truncation issues (e.g., 209.9999 -> 210, not 209)
    90→        let calc_watts = |percent: f32| -> u16 { (ftp as f32 * percent).round() as u16 };
    91→
    92→        Self {
    93→            z1_recovery: ZoneRange {
    94→                zone: 1,
    95→                min_percent: 0,
    96→                max_percent: 55,
    97→                min_watts: 0,
    98→                max_watts: calc_watts(0.55),
    99→                color: POWER_ZONE_COLORS[0],
   100→                name: "Active Recovery".to_string(),
   101→            },
   102→            z2_endurance: ZoneRange {
   103→                zone: 2,
   104→                min_percent: 56,
   105→                max_percent: 75,
   106→                min_watts: calc_watts(0.56),
   107→                max_watts: calc_watts(0.75),
   108→                color: POWER_ZONE_COLORS[1],
   109→                name: "Endurance".to_string(),
   110→            },
   111→            z3_tempo: ZoneRange {
   112→                zone: 3,
   113→                min_percent: 76,
   114→                max_percent: 90,
   115→                min_watts: calc_watts(0.76),
   116→                max_watts: calc_watts(0.90),
   117→                color: POWER_ZONE_COLORS[2],
   118→                name: "Tempo".to_string(),
   119→            },
   120→            z4_threshold: ZoneRange {
   121→                zone: 4,
   122→                min_percent: 91,
   123→                max_percent: 105,
   124→                min_watts: calc_watts(0.91),
   125→                max_watts: calc_watts(1.05),
   126→                color: POWER_ZONE_COLORS[3],
   127→                name: "Threshold".to_string(),
   128→            },
   129→            z5_vo2max: ZoneRange {
   130→                zone: 5,
   131→                min_percent: 106,
   132→                max_percent: 120,
   133→                min_watts: calc_watts(1.06),
   134→                max_watts: calc_watts(1.20),
   135→                color: POWER_ZONE_COLORS[4],
   136→                name: "VO2max".to_string(),
   137→            },
   138→            z6_anaerobic: ZoneRange {
   139→                zone: 6,
   140→                min_percent: 121,
   141→                max_percent: 150,
   142→                min_watts: calc_watts(1.21),
   143→                max_watts: calc_watts(1.50),
   144→                color: POWER_ZONE_COLORS[5],
   145→                name: "Anaerobic".to_string(),
   146→            },
   147→            z7_neuromuscular: ZoneRange {
   148→                zone: 7,
   149→                min_percent: 151,
   150→                max_percent: 255,
   151→                min_watts: calc_watts(1.51),
   152→                max_watts: u16::MAX,
   153→                color: POWER_ZONE_COLORS[6],
   154→                name: "Neuromuscular".to_string(),
   155→            },
   156→            custom: false,
   157→        }
   158→    }
   159→
   160→    /// Get the zone for a given power value.
   161→    pub fn get_zone(&self, power: u16) -> u8 {
   162→        if power <= self.z1_recovery.max_watts {
   163→            1
   164→        } else if power <= self.z2_endurance.max_watts {
   165→            2
   166→        } else if power <= self.z3_tempo.max_watts {
   167→            3
   168→        } else if power <= self.z4_threshold.max_watts {
   169→            4
   170→        } else if power <= self.z5_vo2max.max_watts {
   171→            5
   172→        } else if power <= self.z6_anaerobic.max_watts {
   173→            6
   174→        } else {
   175→            7
   176→        }
   177→    }
   178→
   179→    /// Get the zone range for a given zone number (1-7).
   180→    pub fn get_zone_range(&self, zone: u8) -> Option<&ZoneRange> {
   181→        match zone {
   182→            1 => Some(&self.z1_recovery),
   183→            2 => Some(&self.z2_endurance),
   184→            3 => Some(&self.z3_tempo),
   185→            4 => Some(&self.z4_threshold),
   186→            5 => Some(&self.z5_vo2max),
   187→            6 => Some(&self.z6_anaerobic),
   188→            7 => Some(&self.z7_neuromuscular),
   189→            _ => None,
   190→        }
   191→    }
   192→
   193→    /// Get all zones as a vector.
   194→    pub fn all_zones(&self) -> Vec<&ZoneRange> {
   195→        vec![
   196→            &self.z1_recovery,
   197→            &self.z2_endurance,
   198→            &self.z3_tempo,
   199→            &self.z4_threshold,
   200→            &self.z5_vo2max,
   201→            &self.z6_anaerobic,
   202→            &self.z7_neuromuscular,
   203→        ]
   204→    }
   205→
   206→    /// Update zones based on a new FTP value.
   207→    ///
   208→    /// T075: Trigger zone recalculation on FTP acceptance.
   209→    /// Returns the new zones calculated from the updated FTP.
   210→    pub fn update_from_ftp(&mut self, new_ftp: u16) {
   211→        *self = Self::from_ftp(new_ftp);
   212→    }
   213→}

   215→impl Default for PowerZones {
   216→    fn default() -> Self {
   217→        // Default to 200W FTP as a reasonable starting point
   218→        Self::from_ftp(200)
   219→    }
   220→}

   222→/// Karvonen 5-zone heart rate zones.
   223→#[derive(Debug, Clone, Serialize, Deserialize)]
   224→pub struct HRZones {

I've created a comprehensive implementation plan for the **Add Cadence Zones System** feature. Here's a summary:

## Implementation Plan Summary

### 7 Phases with 25 Subtasks

| Phase | Name | Subtasks | Description |
|-------|------|----------|-------------|
| 1 | Core Cadence Zone Types | 5 | Define `CadenceZoneRange`, `CadenceZones` structs, colors, and methods |
| 2 | Zone Tracker Integration | 4 | Add cadence tracking to `ZoneTracker` with zone change events |
| 3 | MetricsCalculator Integration | 3 | Add `cadence_zone` to metrics pipeline |
| 4 | Module Exports and Config | 3 | Export types and update configuration |
| 5 | UI Integration | 3 | Add cadence zone indicator widget |
| 6 | Unit Tests | 4 | Comprehensive test coverage |
| 7 | Verification and Cleanup | 3 | Final build verification and documentation |

### Key Design Decisions

**Cadence Zone Model (5 zones):**
| Zone | Name | RPM Range | Purpose |
|------|------|-----------|---------|
| Z1 | Low | 0-75 | Recovery/climbing |
| Z2 | Economy | 76-85 | Steady state endurance |
| Z3 | Natural | 86-95 | Natural cadence, tempo |
| Z4 | Fast | 96-105 | High cadence training |
| Z5 | Sprint | 106+ | High cadence drills |

### Pattern Adherence
The implementation follows existing patterns from:
- `PowerZones` (7-zone Coggan model)
- `HRZones` (5-zone Karvonen model)
- `ZoneTracker` for zone change event detection

### Files to Modify
- `src/metrics/zones.rs` - Core zone types and tracking
- `src/metrics/calculator.rs` - Metrics integration
- `src/metrics/mod.rs` - Module exports
- `src/storage/config.rs` - Configuration types
- `src/ui/widgets/zone_indicator.rs` - UI display
- `tests/unit/zones_test.rs` - Integration tests

The plan is ready for implementation. The first subtask is to **define the `CadenceZoneRange` struct** in `zones.rs`.

1→﻿# RustRide - Claude Code Context
     2→
     3→## Project Overview
     4→
     5→RustRide is an open-source, self-hosted indoor cycling training application built in Rust. It provides BLE sensor connectivity (smart trainers, power meters, HR monitors), structured workout execution with ERG mode control, real-time metrics display, ride recording, and export to standard formats (.fit, .tcx).
     6→
     7→## Technology Stack
     8→
     9→| Component | Technology |
    10→|-----------|------------|
    11→| Language | Rust stable (1.75+) |
    12→| GUI Framework | egui + eframe (0.33+) |
    13→| Accessibility | accesskit (built into eframe) |
    14→| BLE Communication | btleplug |
    15→| Audio | rodio |
    16→| Voice Control | vosk (optional feature) |
    17→| Async Runtime | tokio |
    18→| Database | SQLite via rusqlite |
    19→| Configuration | TOML via toml crate |
    20→| Internationalization | fluent, fluent-langneg, unic-langid |
    21→| Theme Detection | dark-light |
    22→| Logging | tracing |
    23→| Serialization | serde |
    24→
    25→## Project Structure
    26→
    27→```
    28→src/
    29→├── main.rs              # Application entry point
    30→├── app.rs               # egui application state
    31→├── lib.rs               # Library exports
    32→├── accessibility/       # Accessibility features (WCAG 2.1 AA/AAA)
    33→│   ├── colorblind.rs    # Colorblind-safe palettes
    34→│   ├── focus.rs         # Keyboard focus management
    35→│   ├── high_contrast.rs # High contrast mode
    36→│   ├── screen_reader.rs # Screen reader support (accesskit)
    37→│   └── voice_control.rs # Voice control (optional Vosk feature)
    38→├── audio/               # Audio system (rodio)
    39→│   ├── engine.rs        # Audio engine
    40→│   └── tones.rs         # Tone generation for cues
    41→├── i18n/                # Internationalization (fluent)
    42→├── input/               # Input handling
    43→│   ├── keyboard.rs      # Keyboard shortcuts
    44→│   ├── touch.rs         # Touch input
    45→│   └── gestures.rs      # Gesture recognition
    46→├── onboarding/          # First-run onboarding wizard
    47→├── sensors/             # BLE/ANT+ sensor management
    48→├── workouts/            # Workout parsing and execution
    49→├── recording/           # Ride recording and file export
    50→├── metrics/             # Training metric calculations
    51→├── storage/             # SQLite and config persistence
    52→└── ui/                  # egui screens and widgets
    53→    ├── screens/         # Main application screens
    54→    ├── widgets/         # Reusable UI components
    55→    ├── display_modes/   # Flow mode, TV mode
    56→    ├── layout/          # Widget layout management
    57→    └── theme.rs         # Theme detection and management
    58→
    59→tests/
    60→├── unit/               # Unit tests
    61→├── integration/        # Integration tests
    62→└── fixtures/           # Test data (workouts, rides)
    63→
    64→specs/                  # Feature specifications
    65→├── 001-indoor-cycling-app/  # MVP cycling features
    66→├── 008-ux-accessibility/    # UX & Accessibility features
    67→│   ├── spec.md         # Feature specification
    68→│   ├── plan.md         # Implementation plan
    69→│   └── tasks.md        # Implementation tasks
    70→```
    71→
    72→## Key Modules
    73→
    74→### sensors/
    75→BLE sensor discovery and connection using btleplug. Supports:
    76→- FTMS (Fitness Machine Service) for smart trainers
    77→- Cycling Power Service for power meters
    78→- Heart Rate Service for HR monitors
    79→
    80→### workouts/
    81→Workout file parsing (.zwo, .mrc) and execution engine. Manages:
    82→- Workout state machine (start, pause, resume, skip)
    83→- ERG mode power target calculations
    84→- Interval timing and transitions
    85→
    86→### recording/
    87→Ride data capture and export. Features:
    88→- 1-second sample recording
    89→- Auto-save for crash recovery (30-second intervals)
    90→- Export to TCX, FIT, GPX, CSV formats
    91→
    92→### metrics/
    93→Training metric calculations:
    94→- Normalized Power (NP)
    95→- Training Stress Score (TSS)
    96→- Intensity Factor (IF)
    97→- Power and HR zone calculations
    98→
    99→### storage/
   100→Data persistence:
   101→- SQLite for rides, workouts, sensors
   102→- TOML for user configuration
   103→- Auto-migrations on startup
   104→
   105→## Development Commands
   106→
   107→```bash
   108→# Build
   109→cargo build              # Debug build
   110→cargo build --release    # Release build
   111→
   112→# Test
   113→cargo test               # Run all tests
   114→cargo test sensors       # Test specific module
   115→
   116→# Run
   117→cargo run                # Debug mode
   118→cargo run --release      # Release mode
   119→
   120→# Code quality
   121→cargo fmt                # Format code
   122→cargo clippy             # Lint
   123→```
   124→
   125→## Important Patterns
   126→
   127→### Thread Communication
   128→- Use `crossbeam::channel` for sensor data (BLE → UI)
   129→- Use `Arc<Mutex<T>>` for shared state (ride samples)
   130→- Call `ctx.request_repaint()` from background threads to wake UI
   131→
   132→### BLE Protocol
   133→- FTMS Control Point writes for ERG mode: `[0x05, watts_lo, watts_hi]`
   134→- Always request control (`[0x00]`) before setting targets
   135→- Handle automatic reconnection on signal loss
   136→
   137→### Metrics Calculations
   138→- Normalized Power: 30s rolling average → 4th power → mean → 4th root
   139→- TSS = (hours × IF²) × 100
   140→- Filter power spikes > 2000W as noise
   141→
   142→## Configuration Locations
   143→
   144→- **Windows**: `%APPDATA%\rustride\`
   145→- **macOS**: `~/Library/Application Support/rustride/`
   146→- **Linux**: `~/.config/rustride/` (config), `~/.local/share/rustride/` (data)
   147→
   148→## Accessibility Features
   149→
   150→The application follows WCAG 2.1 AA/AAA guidelines:
   151→
   152→### Keyboard Navigation
   153→- Tab/Shift+Tab for focus navigation
   154→- Enter/Space for button activation
   155→- Escape to close modals
   156→- F1/? to show keyboard shortcuts overlay
   157→- Ctrl+M for screen reader metrics announcement
   158→
   159→### Visual Accessibility
   160→- High contrast mode (7:1 WCAG AAA ratio)
   161→- Colorblind-safe palettes (deuteranopia, protanopia, tritanopia)
   162→- System theme detection and follow (dark/light)
   163→- Minimum 44x44px touch targets
   164→
   165→### Screen Reader Support
   166→- AccessKit integration (NVDA, VoiceOver, Orca)
   167→- Live regions for interval changes
   168→- Immediate alert announcements
   169→- Focus management for modal dialogs
   170→
   171→### Voice Control (optional)
   172→Enable with `--features voice-control`:
   173→- Commands: start, pause, resume, end, skip
   174→- Increase/decrease power targets
   175→- Status announcements
   176→
   177→### Touch/Gesture Support
   178→- Swipe navigation between screens
   179→- Pinch-zoom for charts
   180→- 44x44 minimum touch targets
   181→- Visual touch feedback (ripple/scale/highlight)
   182→
   183→## Current Feature: 001-indoor-cycling-app
   184→
   185→MVP implementation covering:
   186→- P1: Connect smart trainer and start free ride
   187→- P2: Execute structured workouts with ERG mode
   188→- P3: Record and export ride data
   189→- P4: Real-time training metrics display
   190→- P5: User profile and training zones
   191→- P6: Ride history browsing
   192→- P7: Multi-sensor support
   193→
   194→See `specs/001-indoor-cycling-app/` for full specifications.
   195→
